summary: Wiley welcomes responsible author use of AI as a companion to writing, provided authors stay fully accountable, check tool terms for rights, and disclose substantive uses (text generation, methodology, visuals) but not simple grammar or formatting help. AI cannot be an author, and AI-edited photographs and factual or evidential images are not permitted. Reviewers and editors may use AI only for things like polishing feedback, must never upload manuscripts (even in part), and reviewers must disclose AI used for drafting reviews.

evidence.quote: Wiley welcomes the thoughtful use of AI Technology.
Simple grammar correction, formatting, and word choice suggestions typically do not require disclosure.
these tools cannot fulfil the role of, nor be listed as, an author of an article.
AI-edited photographs are not permitted in Wiley journals.
Manuscripts under review are confidential and must not be uploaded to AI Technologies, whether in full or in part.
Use AI to improve review clarity and tone or translate your review
